## Use this capability when the user means

- create an anonymous inbox
- let friends send anonymous messages
- reveal an anonymous message
- make an anonymous feedback profile

## Authority

public offer discovery, free anonymous message submission and human-confirmed paid reveal; locked content remains unavailable until authoritative payment verification

## Commercial state

- Status: payment_runtime_verified
- Offer: Anonymous message submission · Free
- Offer: Reveal one selected locked message · $0.99 one-time
- Payment state: Explicit user confirmation and authoritative completed-payment verification required before reveal

## Boundaries

- anonymous message content remains server-side locked before verified payment
- do not expose owner tokens, recovery secrets or administrative data
- checkout creation and synthetic tests are not revenue
- a reveal entitlement exists only after independent verification of the exact completed payment

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
